verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੇ ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pahile gur upadhes dhe sikh pairee paae|

en.bdb: First the Guru making the disciple sit near his feet preaches to him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat kar dharamasaal sikh sevaa laae|

en.bdb: Telling him about the distinction of the holy congregation and the abode of dharma, he is put into the service (of the mankind).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhai sevadhe gurapurab karaae|

en.bdb: Serving through loving devotion, the servants of the Lord celebrate the anniversaries.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv keeratan sach mel milaae|

en.bdb: Attuning the consciousness with the Word, through the singing of hymns, one meets the truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag sach dhaa sach paar la(n)ghaae|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh walks the path of Truth; practicing Truth he crosses the Worldly ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: sach milai sachiaar no mil aap gavaae ||17||

en.bdb: Thus the truthful one obtains the truth and getting it, the ego is erased.
